svg.title: SOPS and age secret handling
svg.desc: Version encrypted credentials. Decrypt only at the point of use.

g.text: Version encrypted credentials. Decrypt only at the point of use.
SOPS encrypts values; age wraps the file data key.
secrets/lab.sops.yaml stores encrypted values, a MAC, and the wrapped data key.
Keep the raw data key and age private identity outside Git.
An authorized private identity unwraps the data key.
Remove temporary plaintext after use. Keep secrets out of logs and arguments.
